description: This file defines the ToDoItemControlRenderer class, a custom renderer for ToDoItemControl components in a TodoMVC application, handling DOM structure and CSS classes.

classes.name: todomvc.view.ToDoItemControlRenderer
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for rendering and updating the DOM for ToDoItemControl components, including managing states and DOM element retrieval.

methods.name: createDom
methods.description: Creates the DOM element for the control based on its content and checked state.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Updates the visual state of the control, such as checked or editing.

methods.name: getKeyEventTarget
methods.description: Returns the element that should receive keyboard focus.

methods.name: getDisplayElement
methods.description: Returns the main display element of the control.

methods.name: getContentElement
methods.description: Returns the element containing the control's content.

methods.name: getCheckboxElement
methods.description: Returns the checkbox element within the control.

methods.name: getInputElement
methods.description: Returns the input element within the control.
